goal: Keep at least one active human administrator.

runtime.reason: The last human administrator is required for recoverable administration.

goal: Set the maximum number of days ahead an operator slide_next_cycle command may schedule the next subscription cycle (operator slide max days, operator reschedule window, support slide limit).
whyThisDefault: Sixty days preserves the historical operator slide_next_cycle ceiling in customer_support_apply_subscription_action_v1 while matching customer subscription reschedule bounds.

effect.appliesTo: Subsequent fresh calls to customer_support_apply_subscription_action_v1 read key='account_support_operator_slide_max_days' from public.commerce_settings via account_support_operator_slide_max_days_read(), validating optional payload slideMinDays (1..maxDays) and accepting slide_next_cycle targets through now + make_interval(days => maxDays) before delegating slideMaxDays to eight-argument subscription_command_apply. When no row exists in public.commerce_settings, the SQL reader defaults to 60 days; malformed rows refuse fail-closed with SQLSTATE 22023 account_support_operator_slide_max_days_policy_invalid.
frozenOn: Already scheduled subscription cycles and completed customer_support_subscription_commands receipts (including idempotent replays) retain their recorded dates and outcomes.

runtime.reason: Install or update the public.commerce_settings row through installAccountSupportOperatorSlideMaxDaysPolicy or your store deployment step; runtime edits require a write-capable host connection.

rules.description: Supply exactly revision and maxDays. Revision must be a nonblank string and maxDays an integer from 3 through 365.
